1	"""Сервис складского учёта: приход, расход, перемещение, инвентаризация.
2	
3	Любая операция, меняющая остатки, пишет событие в журнал
4	(:class:`~warehouse.events.EventLog`). Операция либо выполняется целиком,
5	либо не меняет ничего — ни остатков, ни журнала.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import logging
11	from dataclasses import replace
12	from datetime import datetime, timedelta
13	from typing import Iterable
14	
15	from .clock import Clock, SystemClock
16	from .errors import (
17	    DuplicateReservationError,
18	    DuplicateSkuError,
19	    InsufficientStockError,
20	    InvalidQuantityError,
21	    ReservationExpiredError,
22	    ReservationNotFoundError,
23	    ReservationStateError,
24	    UnknownSkuError,
25	    ValidationError,
26	)
27	from .events import EventLog, format_timestamp
28	from .models import Reservation, ReservationLine, ReservationStatus, Sku, StockLevel
29	from .reservations import DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL, check_ttl, effective_status, line_totals
30	from .storage import InMemoryStore
31	
32	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
33	
34	
35	class Inventory:
36	    """Остатки товаров по складам."""
37	
38	    def __init__(
39	        self,
40	        store: InMemoryStore | None = None,
41	        clock: Clock | None = None,
42	        log: EventLog | None = None,
43	    ) -> None:
44	        self._store = store if store is not None else InMemoryStore()
45	        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else SystemClock()
46	        self._log = log if log is not None else EventLog()
47	
48	    @property
49	    def store(self) -> InMemoryStore:
50	        return self._store
51	
52	    @property
53	    def clock(self) -> Clock:
54	        return self._clock
55	
56	    @property
57	    def log(self) -> EventLog:
58	        return self._log
59	
60	    # --- справочник ---------------------------------------------------------
61	
62	    def register_sku(self, code: str, name: str, unit: str = "pcs") -> Sku:
63	        _validate_code(code, "SKU code")
64	        if self._store.has_sku(code):
65	            raise DuplicateSkuError(code)
66	        sku = Sku(code=code, name=name, unit=unit)
67	        self._store.add_sku(sku)
68	        logger.info("registered SKU %s", code)
69	        return sku
70	
71	    def get_sku(self, code: str) -> Sku:
72	        sku = self._store.get_sku(code)
73	        if sku is None:
74	            raise UnknownSkuError(code)
75	        return sku
76	
77	    # --- запросы ------------------------------------------------------------
78	
79	    def on_hand(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
80	        """Физический остаток SKU на складе."""
81	        self._require_sku(sku)
82	        return self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
83	
84	    def stock_levels(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> list[StockLevel]:
85	        """Ненулевые физические остатки, отсортированные по складу и SKU."""
86	        return [
87	            StockLevel(warehouse=wh, sku=sku, on_hand=qty)
88	            for wh, sku, qty in self._store.positions()
89	            if warehouse is None or wh == warehouse
90	        ]
91	
92	    def reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
93	        """Сумма активных резервов по позиции."""
94	        self._require_sku(sku)
95	        return self._reserved(warehouse, sku, self._clock.now())
96	
97	    def available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
98	        """Физический остаток минус активные резервы, но не меньше нуля."""
99	        self._require_sku(sku)
100	        return self._available(warehouse, sku, self._clock.now())
101	
102	    # --- операции -----------------------------------------------------------
103	
104	    def receive(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
105	        """Приход товара. Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
106	        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
107	        _validate_qty(qty)
108	        _validate_ref(ref)
109	        new_qty = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) + qty
110	        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, new_qty)
111	        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RECEIVE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
112	        logger.info("received %s x%d at %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
113	        return new_qty
114	
115	    def issue(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
116	        """Расход (отгрузка, списание). Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
117	        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
118	        _validate_qty(qty)
119	        _validate_ref(ref)
120	        now = self._clock.now()
121	        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
122	        available = self._available(warehouse, sku, now)
123	        if qty > available:
124	            raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, available)
125	        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, current - qty)
126	        self._log.append(now, "ISSUE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
127	        logger.info("issued %s x%d from %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
128	        return current - qty
129	
130	    def transfer(
131	        self, source: str, target: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None
132	    ) -> None:
133	        """Перемещение между складами одним событием ``TRANSFER``.
134	
135	        Для склада-источника это обычный расход: проверки те же, что у :meth:`issue`.
136	        """
137	        self._check_position(source, sku)
138	        _validate_code(target, "warehouse")
139	        if source == target:
140	            raise ValidationError("source and target warehouses must differ")
141	        _validate_qty(qty)
142	        _validate_ref(ref)
143	        now = self._clock.now()
144	        current = self._store.get_qty(source, sku)
145	        available = self._available(source, sku, now)
146	        if qty > available:
147	            raise InsufficientStockError(source, sku, qty, available)
148	        self._store.set_qty(source, sku, current - qty)
149	        self._store.set_qty(target, sku, self._store.get_qty(target, sku) + qty)
150	        self._log.append(now, "TRANSFER", src=source, dst=target, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
151	        logger.info("moved %s x%d %s -> %s", sku, qty, source, target)
152	
153	    def adjust(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, counted: int, reason: str) -> int:
154	        """Инвентаризация: фиксирует фактически посчитанный остаток.
155	
156	        Это факт, а не запрос, поэтому никаких проверок достаточности нет.
157	        В журнал пишется разница ``delta`` (может быть отрицательной).
158	        """
159	        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
160	        if isinstance(counted, bool) or not isinstance(counted, int) or counted < 0:
161	            raise ValidationError(f"counted quantity must be a non-negative integer, got {counted!r}")
162	        _validate_code(reason, "reason")
163	        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
164	        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, counted)
165	        self._log.append(
166	            self._clock.now(), "ADJUST", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, delta=counted - current, reason=reason
167	        )
168	        logger.warning("stock of %s at %s adjusted %d -> %d", sku, warehouse, current, counted)
169	        return counted
170	
171	    # --- резервы ------------------------------------------------------------
172	
173	    def reserve(
174	        self,
175	        order_id: str,
176	        lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
177	        ttl: timedelta | None = None,
178	    ) -> Reservation:
179	        """Держит товар под заказ по всем строкам сразу. Физический остаток не меняется.
180	
181	        Заменить можно только резерв, который истёк или отменён.
182	        """
183	        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
184	        ttl = DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL if ttl is None else check_ttl(ttl)
185	        normalized = self._normalize_lines(lines)
186	        now = self._clock.now()
187	        existing = self._store.get_reservation(order_id)
188	        if existing is not None and effective_status(existing, now) in (
189	            ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
190	            ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED,
191	        ):
192	            raise DuplicateReservationError(order_id)
193	        for (warehouse, sku), needed in line_totals(normalized).items():
194	            available = self._available(warehouse, sku, now)
195	            if needed > available:
196	                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, needed, available)
197	        reservation = Reservation(
198	            order_id=order_id,
199	            lines=normalized,
200	            created_at=now,
201	            expires_at=now + ttl,
202	            status=ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
203	        )
204	        self._store.set_reservation(reservation)
205	        expires = format_timestamp(reservation.expires_at)
206	        for line in normalized:
207	            self._log.append(
208	                now, "RESERVE", order=order_id, wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku,
209	                qty=line.qty, expires=expires,
210	            )
211	        logger.info("reserved order %s, %d lines", order_id, len(normalized))
212	        return reservation
213	
214	    def confirm(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
215	        """Превращает активный резерв в отгрузку: физический остаток списывается по строкам."""
216	        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
217	        now = self._clock.now()
218	        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
219	        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
220	            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
221	        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
222	            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
223	        for (warehouse, sku), needed in line_totals(reservation.lines).items():
224	            on_hand = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
225	            if needed > on_hand:
226	                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, needed, on_hand)
227	        for line in reservation.lines:
228	            remaining = self._store.get_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku) - line.qty
229	            self._store.set_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku, remaining)
230	            self._log.append(
231	                now, "ISSUE", wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku, qty=line.qty, ref=order_id
232	            )
233	        confirmed = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED)
234	        self._store.set_reservation(confirmed)
235	        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CONFIRM", order=order_id)
236	        logger.info("confirmed order %s", order_id)
237	        return confirmed
238	
239	    def cancel(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
240	        """Освобождает активный резерв. Повторная отмена и отмена истёкшего ничего не пишут."""
241	        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
242	        status = effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now())
243	        if status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED:
244	            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
245	        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
246	            return replace(reservation, status=status)
247	        cancelled = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CANCELLED)
248	        self._store.set_reservation(cancelled)
249	        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RESERVE_CANCEL", order=order_id)
250	        logger.info("cancelled reservation of order %s", order_id)
251	        return cancelled
252	
253	    def extend(self, order_id: str, ttl: timedelta) -> Reservation:
254	        """Продлевает активный резерв: новый срок ``now + ttl``, но срок никогда не сокращается."""
255	        check_ttl(ttl)
256	        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
257	        now = self._clock.now()
258	        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
259	        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
260	            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
261	        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
262	            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
263	        new_expires = now + ttl
264	        if new_expires <= reservation.expires_at:
265	            return reservation
266	        extended = replace(reservation, expires_at=new_expires)
267	        self._store.set_reservation(extended)
268	        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_EXTEND", order=order_id, expires=format_timestamp(new_expires))
269	        logger.info("extended reservation of order %s", order_id)
270	        return extended
271	
272	    def get_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
273	        """Снимок резерва со статусом на текущий момент."""
274	        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
275	        return replace(reservation, status=effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now()))
276	
277	    # --- служебное ----------------------------------------------------------
278	
279	    def _require_sku(self, sku: str) -> None:
280	        if not self._store.has_sku(sku):
281	            raise UnknownSkuError(sku)
282	
283	    def _check_position(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> None:
284	        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
285	        self._require_sku(sku)
286	
287	    def _reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, now: datetime) -> int:
288	        return sum(
289	            line.qty
290	            for reservation in self._store.reservations()
291	            if effective_status(reservation, now) is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
292	            for line in reservation.lines
293	            if line.warehouse == warehouse and line.sku == sku
294	        )
295	
296	    def _available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, now: datetime) -> int:
297	        return max(0, self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) - self._reserved(warehouse, sku, now))
298	
299	    def _get_reservation_or_raise(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
300	        reservation = self._store.get_reservation(order_id)
301	        if reservation is None:
302	            raise ReservationNotFoundError(order_id)
303	        return reservation
304	
305	    def _normalize_lines(
306	        self, lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine]
307	    ) -> tuple[ReservationLine, ...]:
308	        result: list[ReservationLine] = []
309	        for item in lines:
310	            if isinstance(item, ReservationLine):
311	                line = item
312	            elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 3:
313	                line = ReservationLine(*item)
314	            else:
315	                raise ValidationError(f"reservation line must be (warehouse, sku, qty), got {item!r}")
316	            self._check_position(line.warehouse, line.sku)
317	            _validate_qty(line.qty)
318	            result.append(line)
319	        if not result:
320	            raise ValidationError("reservation must have at least one line")
321	        return tuple(result)
322	
323	
324	def _validate_code(value: object, what: str) -> None:
325	    """Коды складов/SKU/ссылок попадают в журнал, поэтому без пробелов."""
326	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or any(ch.isspace() for ch in value) or "=" in value:
327	        raise ValidationError(f"{what} must be a non-empty string without spaces, got {value!r}")
328	
329	
330	def _validate_ref(ref: object) -> None:
331	    if ref is not None:
332	        _validate_code(ref, "ref")
333	
334	
335	def _validate_qty(qty: object) -> None:
336	    if isinstance(qty, bool) or not isinstance(qty, int) or qty <= 0:
337	        raise InvalidQuantityError(qty)

"""Сервис складского учёта: приход, расход, перемещение, инвентаризация.

Любая операция, меняющая остатки, пишет событие в журнал
(:class:`~warehouse.events.EventLog`). Операция либо выполняется целиком,
либо не меняет ничего — ни остатков, ни журнала.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Iterable

from .clock import Clock, SystemClock
from .errors import (
    DuplicateReservationError,
    DuplicateSkuError,
    InsufficientStockError,
    InvalidQuantityError,
    ReservationExpiredError,
    ReservationNotFoundError,
    ReservationStateError,
    UnknownSkuError,
    ValidationError,
)
from .events import EventLog, format_timestamp
from .models import Reservation, ReservationLine, ReservationStatus, Sku, StockLevel
from .reservations import DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL, check_ttl, effective_status, line_totals
from .storage import InMemoryStore

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class Inventory:
    """Остатки товаров по складам."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: InMemoryStore | None = None,
        clock: Clock | None = None,
        log: EventLog | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._store = store if store is not None else InMemoryStore()
        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else SystemClock()
        self._log = log if log is not None else EventLog()

    @property
    def store(self) -> InMemoryStore:
        return self._store

    @property
    def clock(self) -> Clock:
        return self._clock

    @property
    def log(self) -> EventLog:
        return self._log

    # --- справочник ---------------------------------------------------------

    def register_sku(self, code: str, name: str, unit: str = "pcs") -> Sku:
        _validate_code(code, "SKU code")
        if self._store.has_sku(code):
            raise DuplicateSkuError(code)
        sku = Sku(code=code, name=name, unit=unit)
        self._store.add_sku(sku)
        logger.info("registered SKU %s", code)
        return sku

    def get_sku(self, code: str) -> Sku:
        sku = self._store.get_sku(code)
        if sku is None:
            raise UnknownSkuError(code)
        return sku

    # --- запросы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def on_hand(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Физический остаток SKU на складе."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)

    def stock_levels(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> list[StockLevel]:
        """Ненулевые физические остатки, отсортированные по складу и SKU."""
        return [
            StockLevel(warehouse=wh, sku=sku, on_hand=qty)
            for wh, sku, qty in self._store.positions()
            if warehouse is None or wh == warehouse
        ]

    def reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Сумма активных резервов по позиции."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._reserved(warehouse, sku, self._clock.now())

    def available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Физический остаток минус активные резервы, но не меньше нуля."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._available(warehouse, sku, self._clock.now())

    # --- операции -----------------------------------------------------------

    def receive(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Приход товара. Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        new_qty = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) + qty
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, new_qty)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RECEIVE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("received %s x%d at %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return new_qty

    def issue(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Расход (отгрузка, списание). Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        now = self._clock.now()
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        available = self._available(warehouse, sku, now)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, current - qty)
        self._log.append(now, "ISSUE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("issued %s x%d from %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return current - qty

    def transfer(
        self, source: str, target: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Перемещение между складами одним событием ``TRANSFER``.

        Для склада-источника это обычный расход: проверки те же, что у :meth:`issue`.
        """
        self._check_position(source, sku)
        _validate_code(target, "warehouse")
        if source == target:
            raise ValidationError("source and target warehouses must differ")
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        now = self._clock.now()
        current = self._store.get_qty(source, sku)
        available = self._available(source, sku, now)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(source, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(source, sku, current - qty)
        self._store.set_qty(target, sku, self._store.get_qty(target, sku) + qty)
        self._log.append(now, "TRANSFER", src=source, dst=target, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("moved %s x%d %s -> %s", sku, qty, source, target)

    def adjust(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, counted: int, reason: str) -> int:
        """Инвентаризация: фиксирует фактически посчитанный остаток.

        Это факт, а не запрос, поэтому никаких проверок достаточности нет.
        В журнал пишется разница ``delta`` (может быть отрицательной).
        """
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        if isinstance(counted, bool) or not isinstance(counted, int) or counted < 0:
            raise ValidationError(f"counted quantity must be a non-negative integer, got {counted!r}")
        _validate_code(reason, "reason")
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, counted)
        self._log.append(
            self._clock.now(), "ADJUST", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, delta=counted - current, reason=reason
        )
        logger.warning("stock of %s at %s adjusted %d -> %d", sku, warehouse, current, counted)
        return counted

    # --- резервы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def reserve(
        self,
        order_id: str,
        lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
        ttl: timedelta | None = None,
    ) -> Reservation:
        """Держит товар под заказ по всем строкам сразу. Физический остаток не меняется.

        Заменить можно только резерв, который истёк или отменён.
        """
        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
        ttl = DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL if ttl is None else check_ttl(ttl)
        normalized = self._normalize_lines(lines)
        now = self._clock.now()
        existing = self._store.get_reservation(order_id)
        if existing is not None and effective_status(existing, now) in (
            ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
            ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED,
        ):
            raise DuplicateReservationError(order_id)
        for (warehouse, sku), needed in line_totals(normalized).items():
            available = self._available(warehouse, sku, now)
            if needed > available:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, needed, available)
        reservation = Reservation(
            order_id=order_id,
            lines=normalized,
            created_at=now,
            expires_at=now + ttl,
            status=ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
        )
        self._store.set_reservation(reservation)
        expires = format_timestamp(reservation.expires_at)
        for line in normalized:
            self._log.append(
                now, "RESERVE", order=order_id, wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku,
                qty=line.qty, expires=expires,
            )
        logger.info("reserved order %s, %d lines", order_id, len(normalized))
        return reservation

    def confirm(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Превращает активный резерв в отгрузку: физический остаток списывается по строкам."""
        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
        for (warehouse, sku), needed in line_totals(reservation.lines).items():
            on_hand = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
            if needed > on_hand:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, needed, on_hand)
        for line in reservation.lines:
            remaining = self._store.get_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku) - line.qty
            self._store.set_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku, remaining)
            self._log.append(
                now, "ISSUE", wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku, qty=line.qty, ref=order_id
            )
        confirmed = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED)
        self._store.set_reservation(confirmed)
        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CONFIRM", order=order_id)
        logger.info("confirmed order %s", order_id)
        return confirmed

    def cancel(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Освобождает активный резерв. Повторная отмена и отмена истёкшего ничего не пишут."""
        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
        status = effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now())
        if status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            return replace(reservation, status=status)
        cancelled = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CANCELLED)
        self._store.set_reservation(cancelled)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RESERVE_CANCEL", order=order_id)
        logger.info("cancelled reservation of order %s", order_id)
        return cancelled

    def extend(self, order_id: str, ttl: timedelta) -> Reservation:
        """Продлевает активный резерв: новый срок ``now + ttl``, но срок никогда не сокращается."""
        check_ttl(ttl)
        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
        new_expires = now + ttl
        if new_expires <= reservation.expires_at:
            return reservation
        extended = replace(reservation, expires_at=new_expires)
        self._store.set_reservation(extended)
        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_EXTEND", order=order_id, expires=format_timestamp(new_expires))
        logger.info("extended reservation of order %s", order_id)
        return extended

    def get_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Снимок резерва со статусом на текущий момент."""
        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
        return replace(reservation, status=effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now()))

    # --- служебное ----------------------------------------------------------

    def _require_sku(self, sku: str) -> None:
        if not self._store.has_sku(sku):
            raise UnknownSkuError(sku)

    def _check_position(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> None:
        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
        self._require_sku(sku)

    def _reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, now: datetime) -> int:
        return sum(
            line.qty
            for reservation in self._store.reservations()
            if effective_status(reservation, now) is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
            for line in reservation.lines
            if line.warehouse == warehouse and line.sku == sku
        )

    def _available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, now: datetime) -> int:
        return max(0, self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) - self._reserved(warehouse, sku, now))

    def _get_reservation_or_raise(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        reservation = self._store.get_reservation(order_id)
        if reservation is None:
            raise ReservationNotFoundError(order_id)
        return reservation

    def _normalize_lines(
        self, lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine]
    ) -> tuple[ReservationLine, ...]:
        result: list[ReservationLine] = []
        for item in lines:
            if isinstance(item, ReservationLine):
                line = item
            elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 3:
                line = ReservationLine(*item)
            else:
                raise ValidationError(f"reservation line must be (warehouse, sku, qty), got {item!r}")
            self._check_position(line.warehouse, line.sku)
            _validate_qty(line.qty)
            result.append(line)
        if not result:
            raise ValidationError("reservation must have at least one line")
        return tuple(result)


def _validate_code(value: object, what: str) -> None:
    """Коды складов/SKU/ссылок попадают в журнал, поэтому без пробелов."""
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or any(ch.isspace() for ch in value) or "=" in value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{what} must be a non-empty string without spaces, got {value!r}")


def _validate_ref(ref: object) -> None:
    if ref is not None:
        _validate_code(ref, "ref")


def _validate_qty(qty: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(qty, bool) or not isinstance(qty, int) or qty <= 0:
        raise InvalidQuantityError(qty)

"""Правила резервов: срок действия, статус на момент времени, суммы по позициям.

Резервы не имеют фоновых задач: истёк ли резерв, решается по часам сервиса
в момент обращения (см. :func:`effective_status`).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Iterable

from .errors import ValidationError
from .models import Reservation, ReservationLine, ReservationStatus

DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL = timedelta(minutes=15)


def check_ttl(ttl: object) -> timedelta:
    if not isinstance(ttl, timedelta) or ttl <= timedelta(0):
        raise ValidationError(f"reservation ttl must be a positive timedelta, got {ttl!r}")
    return ttl


def effective_status(reservation: Reservation, now: datetime) -> ReservationStatus:
    """Статус резерва на момент ``now``.

    Активный резерв в момент ``expires_at`` и позже считается ``EXPIRED``.
    Остальные статусы окончательные и от времени не зависят.
    """
    if reservation.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE and now >= reservation.expires_at:
        return ReservationStatus.EXPIRED
    return reservation.status


def line_totals(lines: Iterable[ReservationLine]) -> dict[tuple[str, str], int]:
    """Суммы количеств по позициям ``(warehouse, sku)`` в порядке первого появления."""
    totals: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
    for line in lines:
        key = (line.warehouse, line.sku)
        totals[key] = totals.get(key, 0) + line.qty
    return totals

"""Доменные модели. Все модели — неизменяемые датаклассы."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Sku:
    """Позиция справочника номенклатуры."""

    code: str
    name: str
    unit: str = "pcs"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StockLevel:
    """Физический остаток SKU на конкретном складе."""

    warehouse: str
    sku: str
    on_hand: int


class ReservationStatus(str, Enum):
    """Статус резерва. ``EXPIRED`` вычисляется по часам, в хранилище не пишется."""

    ACTIVE = "active"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReservationLine:
    """Строка резерва: сколько единиц SKU на складе держим под заказ."""

    warehouse: str
    sku: str
    qty: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Reservation:
    """Снимок резерва. ``status`` — на момент запроса."""

    order_id: str
    lines: tuple[ReservationLine, ...]
    created_at: datetime
    expires_at: datetime
    status: ReservationStatus

1	"""Журнал складских событий.
2	
3	Каждое событие сериализуется в одну строку::
4	
5	    000003 2026-03-01T10:15:00Z ISSUE qty=2 ref=SO-17 sku=BOLT-M8 wh=MAIN
6	
7	* порядковый номер — 6 цифр, растёт с 1 без пропусков;
8	* время — UTC, формат :data:`TIMESTAMP_FORMAT` (секундная точность, суффикс ``Z``);
9	* тип события — заглавные латинские буквы и ``_``;
10	* поля ``key=value`` в алфавитном порядке ключей, отсутствующее значение — ``-``.
11	
12	Журнал — источник данных для отчётов о движении и для внешней выгрузки,
13	поэтому формат строки менять нельзя.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import logging
19	import re
20	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
21	from datetime import datetime, timezone
22	from types import MappingProxyType
23	from typing import Iterator, Mapping
24	
25	from .errors import EventFormatError
26	
27	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
28	
29	TIMESTAMP_FORMAT = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
30	MISSING = "-"
31	
32	_KIND_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z][A-Z_]*$")
33	_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z_]*$")
34	
35	
36	def format_timestamp(moment: datetime) -> str:
37	    """Момент времени в формате журнала."""
38	    if moment.tzinfo is None:
39	        raise EventFormatError("naive datetime cannot be written to the event log")
40	    return moment.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime(TIMESTAMP_FORMAT)
41	
42	
43	def parse_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
44	    try:
45	        parsed = datetime.strptime(text, TIMESTAMP_FORMAT)
46	    except ValueError as exc:
47	        raise EventFormatError(f"bad timestamp {text!r}") from exc
48	    return parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
49	
50	
51	def _format_value(key: str, value: object) -> str:
52	    if value is None:
53	        return MISSING
54	    if isinstance(value, bool):
55	        raise EventFormatError(f"field {key!r}: booleans are not supported")
56	    if isinstance(value, int):
57	        return str(value)
58	    if isinstance(value, str):
59	        if not value or any(ch.isspace() for ch in value) or "=" in value:
60	            raise EventFormatError(f"field {key!r}: value {value!r} cannot be logged")
61	        return value
62	    raise EventFormatError(f"field {key!r}: unsupported type {type(value).__name__}")
63	
64	
65	@dataclass(frozen=True)
66	class Event:
67	    """Одна запись журнала. Значения полей хранятся уже в строковом виде."""
68	
69	    seq: int
70	    ts: datetime
71	    kind: str
72	    fields: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
73	
74	    def format(self) -> str:
75	        parts = [f"{self.seq:06d}", format_timestamp(self.ts), self.kind]
76	        parts.extend(f"{key}={self.fields[key]}" for key in sorted(self.fields))
77	        return " ".join(parts)
78	
79	    def get(self, key: str) -> str | None:
80	        """Значение поля или ``None``, если поле отсутствует или равно ``-``."""
81	        value = self.fields.get(key)
82	        return None if value in (None, MISSING) else value
83	
84	
85	def parse_line(line: str) -> Event:
86	    """Разбор строки журнала обратно в :class:`Event`."""
87	    tokens = line.strip().split(" ")
88	    if len(tokens) < 3:
89	        raise EventFormatError(f"malformed event line {line!r}")
90	    seq_text, ts_text, kind, *pairs = tokens
91	    if not (len(seq_text) == 6 and seq_text.isdigit()):
92	        raise EventFormatError(f"bad sequence number {seq_text!r}")
93	    if not _KIND_RE.match(kind):
94	        raise EventFormatError(f"bad event kind {kind!r}")
95	    fields: dict[str, str] = {}
96	    for pair in pairs:
97	        key, sep, value = pair.partition("=")
98	        if not sep or not _KEY_RE.match(key) or not value:
99	            raise EventFormatError(f"bad field {pair!r}")
100	        fields[key] = value
101	    return Event(int(seq_text), parse_timestamp(ts_text), kind, MappingProxyType(fields))
102	
103	
104	class EventLog:
105	    """Журнал событий в памяти, только на добавление."""
106	
107	    def __init__(self) -> None:
108	        self._events: list[Event] = []
109	
110	    def append(self, ts: datetime, kind: str, **fields: object) -> Event:
111	        if not _KIND_RE.match(kind):
112	            raise EventFormatError(f"bad event kind {kind!r}")
113	        rendered: dict[str, str] = {}
114	        for key, value in fields.items():
115	            if not _KEY_RE.match(key):
116	                raise EventFormatError(f"bad field name {key!r}")
117	            rendered[key] = _format_value(key, value)
118	        # время в журнале — с точностью до секунды
119	        ts = ts.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)
120	        event = Event(len(self._events) + 1, ts, kind, MappingProxyType(rendered))
121	        self._events.append(event)
122	        logger.debug("event %s", event.format())
123	        return event
124	
125	    def events(self, kind: str | None = None) -> list[Event]:
126	        if kind is None:
127	            return list(self._events)
128	        return [event for event in self._events if event.kind == kind]
129	
130	    def lines(self) -> list[str]:
131	        return [event.format() for event in self._events]
132	
133	    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[Event]:
134	        return iter(list(self._events))
135	
136	    def __len__(self) -> int:
137	        return len(self._events)
138

1	"""Иерархия исключений складского учёта.
2	
3	Все ошибки пакета наследуются от :class:`WarehouseError`, чтобы вызывающий
4	код (CLI, интеграции) мог ловить их одним ``except``.
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	
10	class WarehouseError(Exception):
11	    """Базовое исключение пакета ``warehouse``."""
12	
13	
14	class ValidationError(WarehouseError):
15	    """Некорректные входные данные (пустой код, пробелы в идентификаторе и т.п.)."""
16	
17	
18	class InvalidQuantityError(ValidationError):
19	    """Количество должно быть целым положительным числом."""
20	
21	    def __init__(self, qty: object) -> None:
22	        super().__init__(f"quantity must be a positive integer, got {qty!r}")
23	        self.qty = qty
24	
25	
26	class UnknownSkuError(WarehouseError):
27	    """SKU не зарегистрирован в справочнике."""
28	
29	    def __init__(self, sku: str) -> None:
30	        super().__init__(f"unknown SKU {sku!r}")
31	        self.sku = sku
32	
33	
34	class DuplicateSkuError(WarehouseError):
35	    """SKU с таким кодом уже зарегистрирован."""
36	
37	    def __init__(self, sku: str) -> None:
38	        super().__init__(f"SKU {sku!r} is already registered")
39	        self.sku = sku
40	
41	
42	class InsufficientStockError(WarehouseError):
43	    """Недостаточно товара для операции.
44	
45	    ``requested`` — сколько всего единиц позиции требует операция,
46	    ``available`` — сколько из них сервис мог бы отдать в этот момент.
47	    """
48	
49	    def __init__(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, requested: int, available: int) -> None:
50	        super().__init__(
51	            f"not enough {sku!r} at {warehouse!r}: requested {requested}, available {available}"
52	        )
53	        self.warehouse = warehouse
54	        self.sku = sku
55	        self.requested = requested
56	        self.available = available
57	
58	
59	class EventFormatError(WarehouseError):

1	"""Хранилище в памяти: справочник SKU, физические остатки и резервы по складам."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	from typing import Iterator
6	
7	from .models import Reservation, Sku
8	
9	
10	class InMemoryStore:
11	    """Простое хранилище. Ничего не проверяет — проверки живут в сервисе."""
12	
13	    def __init__(self) -> None:
14	        self._skus: dict[str, Sku] = {}
15	        self._quantities: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
16	        self._reservations: dict[str, Reservation] = {}
17	
18	    # --- справочник ---------------------------------------------------------
19	
20	    def add_sku(self, sku: Sku) -> None:
21	        self._skus[sku.code] = sku
22	
23	    def get_sku(self, code: str) -> Sku | None:
24	        return self._skus.get(code)
25	
26	    def has_sku(self, code: str) -> bool:
27	        return code in self._skus
28	
29	    def list_skus(self) -> list[Sku]:
30	        return sorted(self._skus.values(), key=lambda sku: sku.code)
31	
32	    # --- остатки ------------------------------------------------------------
33	
34	    def get_qty(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
35	        return self._quantities.get((warehouse, sku), 0)
36	
37	    def set_qty(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int) -> None:
38	        if qty == 0:
39	            self._quantities.pop((warehouse, sku), None)
40	        else:
41	            self._quantities[(warehouse, sku)] = qty
42	
43	    def positions(self) -> Iterator[tuple[str, str, int]]:
44	        """Все ненулевые позиции ``(warehouse, sku, qty)`` в стабильном порядке."""
45	        for (warehouse, sku), qty in sorted(self._quantities.items()):
46	            yield warehouse, sku, qty
47	
48	    def warehouses(self) -> list[str]:
49	        return sorted({warehouse for warehouse, _ in self._quantities})
50	
51	    # --- резервы ------------------------------------------------------------
52	
53	    def get_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation | None:
54	        return self._reservations.get(order_id)
55	
56	    def set_reservation(self, reservation: Reservation) -> None:
57	        self._reservations[reservation.order_id] = reservation
58	
59	    def reservations(self) -> list[Reservation]:
60	        """Все резервы как записаны (статус без учёта истечения срока)."""
61	        return list(self._reservations.values())

1	"""Источники времени.
2	
3	Бизнес-код никогда не вызывает ``datetime.now()`` напрямую: часы передаются
4	в :class:`~warehouse.inventory.Inventory` через конструктор. Все моменты
5	времени — timezone-aware, в UTC.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
11	from typing import Protocol
12	
13	from .errors import ValidationError
14	
15	
16	class Clock(Protocol):
17	    """Всё, что умеет возвращать текущий момент (aware datetime в UTC)."""
18	
19	    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
20	
21	
22	class SystemClock:
23	    """Настоящие часы для продакшена и CLI."""
24	
25	    def now(self) -> datetime:
26	        return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
27	
28	
29	class ManualClock:
30	    """Часы, которые двигаются только вручную. Используются в тестах."""
31	
32	    def __init__(self, start: datetime) -> None:
33	        self._now = _require_aware(start)
34	
35	    def now(self) -> datetime:
36	        return self._now
37	
38	    def advance(self, delta: timedelta) -> datetime:
39	        if delta < timedelta(0):
40	            raise ValidationError("clock cannot go backwards")
41	        self._now = self._now + delta
42	        return self._now
43	
44	    def set(self, moment: datetime) -> None:
45	        self._now = _require_aware(moment)
46	
47	
48	def _require_aware(moment: datetime) -> datetime:
49	    if moment.tzinfo is None or moment.utcoffset() is None:
50	        raise ValidationError("naive datetimes are not allowed, pass an aware UTC datetime")
51	    return moment.astimezone(timezone.utc)

# warehouse

Небольшой сервис складского учёта: справочник SKU, физические остатки по складам,
приход / расход / перемещение / инвентаризация и журнал событий.

```
warehouse/
  errors.py     иерархия исключений (всё наследуется от WarehouseError)
  clock.py      источники времени: SystemClock, ManualClock (для тестов)
  models.py     неизменяемые датаклассы предметной области
  reservations.py  резервы: срок действия (TTL), статус на момент времени
  events.py     журнал событий и его строковый формат
  storage.py    хранилище в памяти
  inventory.py  сервис Inventory — вся бизнес-логика
  reports.py    отчёты (только чтение)
  cli.py        командная строка: прогон JSON-сценария
```

## Соглашения

* **Только стандартная библиотека.** Python 3.13, тесты — pytest.
* **Время** берётся только из внедрённых часов (`Inventory(clock=...)`), никаких
  `datetime.now()` в бизнес-коде. Все datetime — aware, в UTC.
* **Количества** — целые положительные `int`; `bool`, дробные и строки отклоняются
  `InvalidQuantityError`.
* **Ошибки** — только наследники `WarehouseError` из `warehouse/errors.py`.
  Ошибки входных данных — `ValidationError` и её наследники. Запросы по позиции
  (`on_hand` и т.п.) для незарегистрированного SKU бросают `UnknownSkuError`,
  для зарегистрированного SKU без остатка возвращают 0.
* **Атомарность.** Операция либо выполняется целиком, либо не меняет ничего —
  ни состояния сервиса, ни журнала: сначала все проверки, потом изменения.
* **Журнал.** Каждая операция, меняющая остатки, пишет событие в `EventLog`.
  Формат строки описан в `events.py` и используется внешней выгрузкой — не менять.
  Время в полях событий пишется тем же форматом, что и время события.
* **Логирование** — модульный логгер `logging.getLogger(__name__)`, без `print`
  (кроме `cli.py`).
* **Модели** — `@dataclass(frozen=True)`; наружу сервис отдаёт снимки, а не
  внутренние изменяемые объекты.

## Запуск

```
python -m pytest -q
python -m warehouse.cli run scenario.json --show log
```

from datetime import timedelta

import pytest

from warehouse.errors import (
    DuplicateReservationError,
    InsufficientStockError,
    ReservationExpiredError,
    ReservationNotFoundError,
    ReservationStateError,
    UnknownSkuError,
    ValidationError,
)
from warehouse.models import ReservationLine, ReservationStatus
from warehouse.reservations import DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL


def test_default_ttl_is_fifteen_minutes():
    assert DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL == timedelta(minutes=15)


def test_reserve_holds_stock_without_changing_on_hand(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 10)
    res = inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 4)])
    assert res.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
    assert res.created_at == clock.now()
    assert res.expires_at == clock.now() + DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL
    assert inv.on_hand("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 10
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 4
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 6


def test_reserve_keeps_lines_as_given(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 10)
    inv.receive("NORTH", "NUT-M8", 10)
    line = ReservationLine("NORTH", "NUT-M8", 2)
    res = inv.reserve("SO-2", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1), line, ("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)])
    assert res.lines == (
        ReservationLine("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1),
        ReservationLine("NORTH", "NUT-M8", 2),
        ReservationLine("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3),
    )
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 4
    assert len(inv.log.events("RESERVE")) == 3


def test_reserve_uses_custom_ttl(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)
    res = inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)], ttl=timedelta(hours=2))
    assert res.expires_at == clock.now() + timedelta(hours=2)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("ttl", [timedelta(0), timedelta(seconds=-1), 60, "1m"])
def test_reserve_rejects_bad_ttl(inv, ttl):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)], ttl=ttl)
    assert len(inv.log) == 1


def test_reserve_without_lines_is_validation_error(inv):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        inv.reserve("SO-1", [])


def test_reserve_insufficient_changes_nothing(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)])
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientStockError) as info:
        inv.reserve("SO-2", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3), ("NORTH", "NUT-M8", 1)])
    assert (info.value.requested, info.value.available) == (3, 2)
    with pytest.raises(ReservationNotFoundError):
        inv.get_reservation("SO-2")
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 3
    assert len(inv.log.events("RESERVE")) == 1


def test_reserve_sums_duplicate_position_lines(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientStockError) as info:
        inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3), ("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)])
    assert info.value.requested == 6
    inv.reserve("SO-2", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 2), ("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)])
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 0


def test_reserve_unknown_sku(inv):
    with pytest.raises(UnknownSkuError):
        inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "NOPE", 1)])


def test_duplicate_reserve_while_active(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])
    with pytest.raises(DuplicateReservationError):
        inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])


def test_duplicate_reserve_after_confirm(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])
    inv.confirm("SO-1")
    with pytest.raises(DuplicateReservationError):
        inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])


def test_reserve_replaces_expired_and_cancelled(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)])
    clock.advance(DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL)
    res = inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 2)])
    assert res.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 2

    inv.cancel("SO-1")
    res = inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)])
    assert res.lines == (ReservationLine("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3),)
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 3


def test_expiry_boundary_is_exact(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)])
    clock.advance(DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL - timedelta(seconds=1))
    assert inv.get_reservation("SO-1").status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 0
    clock.advance(timedelta(seconds=1))
    assert inv.get_reservation("SO-1").status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 0
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 5


def test_expiry_writes_no_events(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)])
    before = len(inv.log)
    clock.advance(timedelta(hours=1))
    inv.get_reservation("SO-1")
    inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8")
    assert len(inv.log) == before


def test_issue_cannot_take_reserved_stock(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 4)])
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientStockError) as info:
        inv.issue("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 2)
    assert (info.value.requested, info.value.available) == (2, 1)
    assert inv.issue("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1) == 4


def test_transfer_cannot_take_reserved_stock(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)])
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientStockError):
        inv.transfer("MAIN", "NORTH", "BOLT-M8", 1)


def test_issue_allowed_after_reservation_expires(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)])
    clock.advance(DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL)
    assert inv.issue("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5) == 0


def test_confirm_ships_and_logs(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 2), ("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])
    res = inv.confirm("SO-1")
    assert res.status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED
    assert inv.on_hand("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 2
    assert inv.reserved("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 0
    issues = inv.log.events("ISSUE")
    assert [(e.fields["qty"], e.fields["ref"]) for e in issues] == [("2", "SO-1"), ("1", "SO-1")]
    assert inv.log.events("RESERVE_CONFIRM")[0].fields["order"] == "SO-1"


def test_confirm_with_zero_available_is_fine(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)])
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 0
    inv.confirm("SO-1")
    assert inv.on_hand("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 0


def test_confirm_expired_raises(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)])
    clock.advance(DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL)
    with pytest.raises(ReservationExpiredError):
        inv.confirm("SO-1")
    assert inv.on_hand("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 3


def test_confirm_twice_or_after_cancel_raises_state_error(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 3)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])
    inv.confirm("SO-1")
    with pytest.raises(ReservationStateError):
        inv.confirm("SO-1")
    inv.reserve("SO-2", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 1)])
    inv.cancel("SO-2")
    with pytest.raises(ReservationStateError):
        inv.confirm("SO-2")


def test_confirm_checks_physical_stock_after_shrinkage(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 4)])
    inv.adjust("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 2, "recount")
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 0
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientStockError) as info:
        inv.confirm("SO-1")
    assert (info.value.requested, info.value.available) == (4, 2)
    assert inv.get_reservation("SO-1").status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
    assert inv.on_hand("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 2
    assert len(inv.log.events("ISSUE")) == 0


def test_cancel_releases_and_is_idempotent(inv):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)])
    assert inv.cancel("SO-1").status is ReservationStatus.CANCELLED
    assert inv.available("MAIN", "BOLT-M8") == 5
    before = len(inv.log)
    assert inv.cancel("SO-1").status is ReservationStatus.CANCELLED
    assert len(inv.log) == before
    assert len(inv.log.events("RESERVE_CANCEL")) == 1


def test_cancel_expired_writes_nothing_and_stays_expired(inv, clock):
    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)
    inv.reserve("SO-1", [("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)])

    assert inv.cancel("SO-1").status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED

    inv.receive("MAIN", "BOLT-M8", 5)

"""Правила резервов: срок действия, статус на момент времени, суммы по позициям.

Резервы не имеют фоновых задач: истёк ли резерв, решается по часам сервиса
в момент обращения (см. :func:`effective_status`).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Iterable

from .errors import ValidationError
from .models import Reservation, ReservationLine, ReservationStatus

DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL = timedelta(minutes=15)


def check_ttl(ttl: object) -> timedelta:
    if not isinstance(ttl, timedelta) or ttl <= timedelta(0):
        raise ValidationError(f"reservation ttl must be a positive timedelta, got {ttl!r}")
    return ttl


def effective_status(reservation: Reservation, now: datetime) -> ReservationStatus:
    """Статус резерва на момент ``now``.

    Активный резерв в момент ``expires_at`` и позже считается ``EXPIRED``.
    Остальные статусы окончательные и от времени не зависят.
    """
    if reservation.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE and now >= reservation.expires_at:
        return ReservationStatus.EXPIRED
    return reservation.status


def line_totals(lines: Iterable[ReservationLine]) -> dict[tuple[str, str], int]:
    """Суммы количеств по позициям ``(warehouse, sku)`` в порядке первого появления."""
    totals: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
    for line in lines:
        key = (line.warehouse, line.sku)
        totals[key] = totals.get(key, 0) + line.qty
    return totals

"""Сервис складского учёта: приход, расход, перемещение, инвентаризация.

Любая операция, меняющая остатки, пишет событие в журнал
(:class:`~warehouse.events.EventLog`). Операция либо выполняется целиком,
либо не меняет ничего — ни остатков, ни журнала.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Iterable

from .clock import Clock, SystemClock
from .errors import (
    DuplicateReservationError,
    DuplicateSkuError,
    InsufficientStockError,
    InvalidQuantityError,
    ReservationExpiredError,
    ReservationNotFoundError,
    ReservationStateError,
    UnknownSkuError,
    ValidationError,
)
from .events import EventLog, format_timestamp
from .models import Reservation, ReservationLine, ReservationStatus, Sku, StockLevel
from .reservations import DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL, check_ttl, effective_status, line_totals
from .storage import InMemoryStore

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class Inventory:
    """Остатки товаров по складам."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: InMemoryStore | None = None,
        clock: Clock | None = None,
        log: EventLog | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._store = store if store is not None else InMemoryStore()
        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else SystemClock()
        self._log = log if log is not None else EventLog()

    @property
    def store(self) -> InMemoryStore:
        return self._store

    @property
    def clock(self) -> Clock:
        return self._clock

    @property
    def log(self) -> EventLog:
        return self._log

    # --- справочник ---------------------------------------------------------

    def register_sku(self, code: str, name: str, unit: str = "pcs") -> Sku:
        _validate_code(code, "SKU code")
        if self._store.has_sku(code):
            raise DuplicateSkuError(code)
        sku = Sku(code=code, name=name, unit=unit)
        self._store.add_sku(sku)
        logger.info("registered SKU %s", code)
        return sku

    def get_sku(self, code: str) -> Sku:
        sku = self._store.get_sku(code)
        if sku is None:
            raise UnknownSkuError(code)
        return sku

    # --- запросы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def on_hand(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Физический остаток SKU на складе."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)

    def stock_levels(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> list[StockLevel]:
        """Ненулевые физические остатки, отсортированные по складу и SKU."""
        return [
            StockLevel(warehouse=wh, sku=sku, on_hand=qty)
            for wh, sku, qty in self._store.positions()
            if warehouse is None or wh == warehouse
        ]

    def reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Сумма активных резервов по позиции."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._reserved(warehouse, sku, self._clock.now())

    def available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Физический остаток минус активные резервы, но не меньше нуля."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._available(warehouse, sku, self._clock.now())

    # --- операции -----------------------------------------------------------

    def receive(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Приход товара. Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        new_qty = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) + qty
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, new_qty)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RECEIVE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("received %s x%d at %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return new_qty

    def issue(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Расход (отгрузка, списание). Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        now = self._clock.now()
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        available = self._available(warehouse, sku, now)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, current - qty)
        self._log.append(now, "ISSUE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("issued %s x%d from %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return current - qty

    def transfer(
        self, source: str, target: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Перемещение между складами одним событием ``TRANSFER``.

        Для склада-источника это обычный расход: проверки те же, что у :meth:`issue`.
        """
        self._check_position(source, sku)
        _validate_code(target, "warehouse")
        if source == target:
            raise ValidationError("source and target warehouses must differ")
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        now = self._clock.now()
        current = self._store.get_qty(source, sku)
        available = self._available(source, sku, now)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(source, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(source, sku, current - qty)
        self._store.set_qty(target, sku, self._store.get_qty(target, sku) + qty)
        self._log.append(now, "TRANSFER", src=source, dst=target, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("moved %s x%d %s -> %s", sku, qty, source, target)

    def adjust(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, counted: int, reason: str) -> int:
        """Инвентаризация: фиксирует фактически посчитанный остаток.

        Это факт, а не запрос, поэтому никаких проверок достаточности нет.
        В журнал пишется разница ``delta`` (может быть отрицательной).
        """
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        if isinstance(counted, bool) or not isinstance(counted, int) or counted < 0:
            raise ValidationError(f"counted quantity must be a non-negative integer, got {counted!r}")
        _validate_code(reason, "reason")
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, counted)
        self._log.append(
            self._clock.now(), "ADJUST", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, delta=counted - current, reason=reason
        )
        logger.warning("stock of %s at %s adjusted %d -> %d", sku, warehouse, current, counted)
        return counted

    # --- резервы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def reserve(
        self,
        order_id: str,
        lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
        ttl: timedelta | None = None,
    ) -> Reservation:
        """Держит товар под заказ по всем строкам сразу. Физический остаток не меняется.

        Заменить можно только резерв, который истёк или отменён.
        """
        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
        ttl = DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL if ttl is None else check_ttl(ttl)
        normalized = self._normalize_lines(lines)
        now = self._clock.now()
        existing = self._store.get_reservation(order_id)
        if existing is not None and effective_status(existing, now) in (
            ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
            ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED,
        ):
            raise DuplicateReservationError(order_id)
        for (warehouse, sku), needed in line_totals(normalized).items():
            available = self._available(warehouse, sku, now)
            if needed > available:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, needed, available)
        reservation = Reservation(
            order_id=order_id,
            lines=normalized,
            created_at=now,
            expires_at=now + ttl,
            status=ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
        )
        self._store.set_reservation(reservation)
        expires = format_timestamp(reservation.expires_at)
        for line in normalized:
            self._log.append(
                now, "RESERVE", order=order_id, wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku,
                qty=line.qty, expires=expires,
            )
        logger.info("reserved order %s, %d lines", order_id, len(normalized))

        # ключи резервов, по которым уже записан RESERVE_EXPIRE (см. _sweep_key)
        self._swept: set[tuple[str, datetime]] = set()
        # истёкшие резервы, которые успели заменить новым до очередного sweep_expired
        self._orphaned_expired: list[Reservation] = []

    @property
    def store(self) -> InMemoryStore:
        return self._store

    @property
    def clock(self) -> Clock:
        return self._clock

    @property
    def log(self) -> EventLog:
        return self._log

    # --- справочник ---------------------------------------------------------

    def register_sku(self, code: str, name: str, unit: str = "pcs") -> Sku:
        _validate_code(code, "SKU code")
        if self._store.has_sku(code):
            raise DuplicateSkuError(code)
        sku = Sku(code=code, name=name, unit=unit)
        self._store.add_sku(sku)
        logger.info("registered SKU %s", code)
        return sku

    def get_sku(self, code: str) -> Sku:
        sku = self._store.get_sku(code)
        if sku is None:
            raise UnknownSkuError(code)
        return sku

    # --- запросы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def on_hand(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Физический остаток SKU на складе."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)

    def stock_levels(self, warehouse: str | None = None) -> list[StockLevel]:
        """Ненулевые физические остатки, отсортированные по складу и SKU."""
        return [
            StockLevel(warehouse=wh, sku=sku, on_hand=qty)
            for wh, sku, qty in self._store.positions()
            if warehouse is None or wh == warehouse
        ]

    def reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Сумма активных резервов по позиции."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._reserved(warehouse, sku, self._clock.now())

    def available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> int:
        """Физический остаток минус активные резервы, но не меньше нуля."""
        self._require_sku(sku)
        return self._available(warehouse, sku, self._clock.now())

    # --- операции -----------------------------------------------------------

    def receive(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Приход товара. Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        new_qty = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) + qty
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, new_qty)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RECEIVE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("received %s x%d at %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return new_qty

    def issue(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None) -> int:
        """Расход (отгрузка, списание). Возвращает новый физический остаток."""
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        now = self._clock.now()
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        available = self._available(warehouse, sku, now)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, current - qty)
        self._log.append(now, "ISSUE", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("issued %s x%d from %s", sku, qty, warehouse)
        return current - qty

    def transfer(
        self, source: str, target: str, sku: str, qty: int, ref: str | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Перемещение между складами одним событием ``TRANSFER``.

        Для склада-источника это обычный расход: проверки те же, что у :meth:`issue`.
        """
        self._check_position(source, sku)
        _validate_code(target, "warehouse")
        if source == target:
            raise ValidationError("source and target warehouses must differ")
        _validate_qty(qty)
        _validate_ref(ref)
        now = self._clock.now()
        current = self._store.get_qty(source, sku)
        available = self._available(source, sku, now)
        if qty > available:
            raise InsufficientStockError(source, sku, qty, available)
        self._store.set_qty(source, sku, current - qty)
        self._store.set_qty(target, sku, self._store.get_qty(target, sku) + qty)
        self._log.append(now, "TRANSFER", src=source, dst=target, sku=sku, qty=qty, ref=ref)
        logger.info("moved %s x%d %s -> %s", sku, qty, source, target)

    def adjust(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, counted: int, reason: str) -> int:
        """Инвентаризация: фиксирует фактически посчитанный остаток.

        Это факт, а не запрос, поэтому никаких проверок достаточности нет.
        В журнал пишется разница ``delta`` (может быть отрицательной).
        """
        self._check_position(warehouse, sku)
        if isinstance(counted, bool) or not isinstance(counted, int) or counted < 0:
            raise ValidationError(f"counted quantity must be a non-negative integer, got {counted!r}")
        _validate_code(reason, "reason")
        current = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
        self._store.set_qty(warehouse, sku, counted)
        self._log.append(
            self._clock.now(), "ADJUST", wh=warehouse, sku=sku, delta=counted - current, reason=reason
        )
        logger.warning("stock of %s at %s adjusted %d -> %d", sku, warehouse, current, counted)
        return counted

    # --- резервы ------------------------------------------------------------

    def reserve(
        self,
        order_id: str,
        lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine],
        ttl: timedelta | None = None,
    ) -> Reservation:
        """Держит товар под заказ по всем строкам сразу. Физический остаток не меняется.

        Заменить можно только резерв, который истёк или отменён.
        """
        _validate_code(order_id, "order id")
        ttl = DEFAULT_RESERVATION_TTL if ttl is None else check_ttl(ttl)
        normalized = self._normalize_lines(lines)
        now = self._clock.now()
        existing = self._store.get_reservation(order_id)
        if existing is not None and effective_status(existing, now) in (
            ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
            ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED,
        ):
            raise DuplicateReservationError(order_id)
        for (warehouse, sku), needed in line_totals(normalized).items():
            available = self._available(warehouse, sku, now)
            if needed > available:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, needed, available)
        reservation = Reservation(
            order_id=order_id,
            lines=normalized,
            created_at=now,
            expires_at=now + ttl,
            status=ReservationStatus.ACTIVE,
        )
        self._store.set_reservation(reservation)
        expires = format_timestamp(reservation.expires_at)
        for line in normalized:
            self._log.append(
                now, "RESERVE", order=order_id, wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku,
                qty=line.qty, expires=expires,
            )
        logger.info("reserved order %s, %d lines", order_id, len(normalized))
        return reservation

    def confirm(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Превращает активный резерв в отгрузку: физический остаток списывается по строкам."""
        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
        for (warehouse, sku), needed in line_totals(reservation.lines).items():
            on_hand = self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku)
            if needed > on_hand:
                raise InsufficientStockError(warehouse, sku, needed, on_hand)
        for line in reservation.lines:
            remaining = self._store.get_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku) - line.qty
            self._store.set_qty(line.warehouse, line.sku, remaining)
            self._log.append(
                now, "ISSUE", wh=line.warehouse, sku=line.sku, qty=line.qty, ref=order_id
            )
        confirmed = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED)
        self._store.set_reservation(confirmed)
        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_CONFIRM", order=order_id)
        logger.info("confirmed order %s", order_id)
        return confirmed

    def cancel(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Освобождает активный резерв. Повторная отмена и отмена истёкшего ничего не пишут."""
        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
        status = effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now())
        if status is ReservationStatus.CONFIRMED:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            return replace(reservation, status=status)
        cancelled = replace(reservation, status=ReservationStatus.CANCELLED)
        self._store.set_reservation(cancelled)
        self._log.append(self._clock.now(), "RESERVE_CANCEL", order=order_id)
        logger.info("cancelled reservation of order %s", order_id)
        return cancelled

    def extend(self, order_id: str, ttl: timedelta) -> Reservation:
        """Продлевает активный резерв: новый срок ``now + ttl``, но срок никогда не сокращается."""
        check_ttl(ttl)
        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
        now = self._clock.now()
        status = effective_status(reservation, now)
        if status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED:
            raise ReservationExpiredError(order_id)
        if status is not ReservationStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise ReservationStateError(order_id, status.value)
        new_expires = now + ttl
        if new_expires <= reservation.expires_at:
            return reservation
        extended = replace(reservation, expires_at=new_expires)
        self._store.set_reservation(extended)
        self._log.append(now, "RESERVE_EXTEND", order=order_id, expires=format_timestamp(new_expires))
        logger.info("extended reservation of order %s", order_id)
        return extended

    def get_reservation(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        """Снимок резерва со статусом на текущий момент."""
        reservation = self._get_reservation_or_raise(order_id)
        return replace(reservation, status=effective_status(reservation, self._clock.now()))

    # --- служебное ----------------------------------------------------------

    def _require_sku(self, sku: str) -> None:
        if not self._store.has_sku(sku):
            raise UnknownSkuError(sku)

    def _check_position(self, warehouse: str, sku: str) -> None:
        _validate_code(warehouse, "warehouse")
        self._require_sku(sku)

    def _reserved(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, now: datetime) -> int:
        return sum(
            line.qty
            for reservation in self._store.reservations()
            if effective_status(reservation, now) is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
            for line in reservation.lines
            if line.warehouse == warehouse and line.sku == sku
        )

    def _available(self, warehouse: str, sku: str, now: datetime) -> int:
        return max(0, self._store.get_qty(warehouse, sku) - self._reserved(warehouse, sku, now))

    def _get_reservation_or_raise(self, order_id: str) -> Reservation:
        reservation = self._store.get_reservation(order_id)
        if reservation is None:
            raise ReservationNotFoundError(order_id)
        return reservation

    def _normalize_lines(
        self, lines: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int] | ReservationLine]
    ) -> tuple[ReservationLine, ...]:
        result: list[ReservationLine] = []
        for item in lines:
            if isinstance(item, ReservationLine):
                line = item
            elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 3:
                line = ReservationLine(*item)
            else:
                raise ValidationError(f"reservation line must be (warehouse, sku, qty), got {item!r}")
            self._check_position(line.warehouse, line.sku)
            _validate_qty(line.qty)
            result.append(line)
        if not result:
            raise ValidationError("reservation must have at least one line")
        return tuple(result)


def _validate_code(value: object, what: str) -> None:
    """Коды складов/SKU/ссылок попадают в журнал, поэтому без пробелов."""
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or any(ch.isspace() for ch in value) or "=" in value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{what} must be a non-empty string without spaces, got {value!r}")


def _validate_ref(ref: object) -> None:
    if ref is not None:
        _validate_code(ref, "ref")


def _validate_qty(qty: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(qty, bool) or not isinstance(qty, int) or qty <= 0:
        raise InvalidQuantityError(qty)
